selection: Every returned original main-market NBA numeric probability for a future exact official fixture with valid saved/calculated pregame timestamps, matching original line/side/quote ID and a fixed candidate. No grade, probability threshold, side or outcome filtering;earliest available original per market/game/player.
timing: Candidate fixed before fresh source retrieval. Original forecast and new recalibrated research probability kept separately. Exact official pregame fixture/time verified. No fitting here.
scoring: Exact completed official finals only;explicit player stats;no missing-to-zero conversion;pushes excluded from binary Brier. Report both original sides, original call hit rate, candidate direction hit rate, conditional Brier and fixture-cluster paired intervals. Constant0.5 comparison only. No odds,EV,ROI or production promotion.
limitations: Selected archived probability cohort, not all players. Original model version/input receipts and two-sided prices are not available in this normalized source. Candidate is retrospective development and not validated;prospective samples cannot establish all-sport accuracy.
